Aquaminder Rio Stainless Steel Double Wall Smart Water Bottle,SS304 Material 750 ml

Stay hydrated in style with the Aquaminder Rio Stainless Steel Double Wall Smart Water Bottle (750 ml). Engineered from premium SS304 stainless steel, this bottle combines smart technology with superior insulation to keep your beverages at the perfect temperature for hours. Its double-wall vacuum construction keeps drinks cold or hot while preventing condensation on the outside.

With its built-in smart reminder system, the Aquaminder Rio actively tracks your hydration and alerts you when it’s time to drink — making it the perfect partner for your fitness routine, office desk, or daily commute. Designed for modern lifestyles, it’s durable, eco-friendly, and stylish, making it more than just a water bottle — it’s your smart hydration companion.

Stay refreshed and on track with your hydration goals with the Aquaminder Rio Stainless Steel Water Bottle (750 ml) — a premium blend of cutting-edge technology, sleek design, and superior insulation. Made from high-grade SS304 food-grade stainless steel, this smart bottle is engineered for durability, safety, and style. Its double-wall vacuum insulation keeps beverages cold or hot for hours while eliminating external condensation, ensuring a comfortable grip at all times.

The integrated smart hydration reminder actively tracks your water intake and alerts you when it’s time to drink, making it your personal hydration coach throughout the day. Whether you’re at the gym, in the office, on the go, or traveling, the Rio keeps you hydrated in the smartest way possible. Its generous 750 ml capacity ensures you meet your daily water requirements without constant refills.

Sustainable and reusable, the Rio is an eco-friendly alternative to disposable Best Its leak-proof design allows you to carry it worry-free in your bag or backpack, while the wide-mouth opening makes it easy to fill, clean, and even add ice cubes or fruit infusions. The modern, ergonomic design and stylish Rio finish make it a versatile accessory that complements any lifestyle — from fitness enthusiasts and travelers to busy professionals. Beyond function, this smart also makes an excellent gift for health-conscious individuals, athletes, or anyone committed to a more sustainable lifestyle.
